text: nice now im going to just give u some real janitor work because i keep somehow unveiling shit that i never asked for and somehow exists and this fucking app isnt even more than 24 hours old lmao. what the fuck is this performance thing up here doing [Image #1] why the hell is it there when at the bottom of the app we have literally a suite of performance metrics on deck
resolution: Removed the redundant 'shell 0.7ms' status pill from the top window chrome (cart/editor/shell/Chrome.tsx). It duplicated a single metric (app_tick_us) that the bottom BuildDock already surfaces as part of its full perf suite (avg/p95/frame/gpu), and whose PerformancePopover breaks out explicitly as 'app tick'. Having a lone perf number floating in the titlebar while a whole metrics dock lives at the bottom was pure redundancy. Also removed the now-dead telemetry wiring (useTelemetry + formatMs imports, the frame poll, the shellMs derivation). The HW_StatusText cls is used widely elsewhere so it stays.
